agent_listen_addr.description: IP address for the SNMP daemon to listen on (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces)

system_name.description: Value for the system.sysName MIB object

system_location.description: Value for the system.sysLocation MIB object

system_contact.description: Value for the system.sysContact MIB object

enable_agentx.description: Enable AgentX protocol support for external subagents (e.g., net-snmp-detect)

agentx_socket_path.description: Path to the AgentX master socket (only used when AgentX is enabled)

communities.description: List of SNMPv1/v2c read-only community strings

write_communities.description: List of SNMPv1/v2c read-write community strings (use with caution)

snmpv3_users.description: List of SNMPv3 users (for secure authentication and encryption)

snmpv3_groups.description: List of SNMPv3 groups mapping users to security levels

snmpv3_access.description: Access control rules for SNMPv3 groups
